rootCause: next build and next dev share .next. A build run after dev compiled routes leaves .next/dev's Turbopack incremental state inconsistent; the next dev start serves documents whose embedded HMR version/chunks no longer match the server, so Next sends reloadPage 'HMR hash mismatch', each reload recompiles and bumps the version, and the page reloads forever.
notes: Deleting only .next/dev (keeping production .next) resolves the loop, proving the stale dev cache is the corrupt artifact, not the CSP, auth, cookies or proxy.
